summary: XNCR is a clinical-stage biotech with a clean balance sheet ($697M cash → 3+ years runway into 2027), tier-2 auditor with 9-year tenure and no disagreements, no going-concern modifier, no debt covenants, non-dilutive royalty monetization ($215M from OMERS), an amended-and-restated Genentech partnership with $600M milestone potential (counterparty expanding commitment), and an orderly CFO succession. The -25.9% drawdown appears to be sector/sentiment-driven, not disclosure-distress-driven. Only mid-severity findings are the revenue lumpiness (Vir collapse offset by Janssen one-time, masking ~70% volatility) and burial of three program terminations in wind-down accounting rather than affirmative scientific disclosure. No SEVERE_UNDERDELIVERY or RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE tuples. Composite reads honest. Verdict: LONG-tier — this is the type of name the honesty-alpha framework should keep (clean disclosure + heavily drawn down = candidate for exclusion-driven LONG basket).
